verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no mention of a data export feature, account settings for exporting chat history/data, or any GDPR-style data portability tool; all cited docs focus on product capabilities like coding, browsing, and image generation, not trust-controls/export functionality. Missing for 10: any documentation of an export-data or download-your-data feature, its scope (chats, files, account info), and delivery mechanism (e.g., email link).
